sections.title: Roof repair contractor serving McAllen
paras: Edel Roofing is based in Edinburg, about 15 minutes from central McAllen, and has been repairing roofs across Hidalgo County since 2003. A leak or damaged section doesn't always mean a full replacement. Most of the time it's a specific, findable problem, a cracked flashing, a section of missing shingles, a failed pipe boot, and it can be fixed in a single visit.

We get repair calls from McAllen homeowners in older neighborhoods around 2nd Street and 10th Street with roofs from the 1980s and 90s, and from newer homes in north McAllen around Sharyland and Las Cumbres where storm damage is the more common cause. Either way, we inspect first and tell you honestly whether it's a repair or something bigger.
A repair call is not an excuse to upsell a replacement. If a repair is the right fix, that's what we recommend and what we do.

cards.title: Leak Repair
cards.body: Interior water stains, active drips, or damp insulation. We trace the leak to its actual entry point, which is often several feet from where the water shows up inside, and repair it there.

cards.title: Storm & Hail Damage Repair
cards.body: Missing or lifted shingles, granule loss, and impact damage from Hidalgo County storms. We document what we find in writing, which is useful if you're filing an insurance claim.

cards.title: Flashing Repair
cards.body: Flashing around chimneys, vents, and roof valleys is one of the most common leak sources on McAllen homes. We reseal or replace failed flashing so water sheds the way it's supposed to.

cards.title: Shingle Replacement (Sections)
cards.body: Cracked, curling, or wind-torn shingles replaced in the affected area, matched as closely as possible to your existing roof.

cards.title: Skylight & Vent Repair
cards.body: Failed skylight seals and roof vent boots are a common, specific leak source. We repair or reseal them without disturbing the rest of the roof.

cards.title: Post-Storm Inspections
cards.body: A full walk of the roof after a hailstorm or high-wind event, with a written report on what needs repair now and what to keep an eye on.

sections.title: What causes most roof repairs in McAllen
paras: McAllen's heat and UV exposure wear down shingles faster than in cooler climates, shingles that look fine from the ground can already be brittle underneath. That's why a lot of our repair calls in older neighborhoods near 2nd Street and 10th Street start with a homeowner noticing a small stain on the ceiling that turns out to be a flashing or vent issue that's been dripping slowly for a while.

In the newer subdivisions around Sharyland and Las Cumbres in north McAllen, storm damage is the more common trigger, a hail event knocks loose a section of shingles or dents the roof enough to compromise the surface, and the homeowner needs both a repair and documentation for their insurance company.
Either way, the fix starts with an honest inspection. We tell you what we actually see, not what generates the biggest invoice.

faqs.q: I have a leak in my McAllen home. Do I need a full roof replacement?
faqs.a: Not usually. Most leaks come from a specific, fixable source, flashing, a vent boot, a section of damaged shingles, and can be repaired without replacing the whole roof. We inspect first and tell you honestly what we find. Call (956) 422-3335 to schedule an inspection.

faqs.q: How much does roof repair cost in McAllen?
faqs.a: Most repairs run a few hundred to around $1,500 depending on what's wrong and how much of the roof is affected. We give a written estimate after inspecting, before any work starts, so you know the number before you commit.

faqs.q: How fast can you repair my roof in McAllen?
faqs.a: We're about 15 minutes from central McAllen and can usually get an inspection scheduled quickly, especially after a storm. Most repairs are completed in a single visit once we know what we're dealing with.

faqs.q: Can you document storm damage for my insurance claim?
faqs.a: Yes. We inspect the roof and provide written documentation of what we find, which is useful when you file with your insurance company. We're not a public adjuster, but we can walk you through exactly what we observed.

faqs.q: How do I get a roof repair estimate in McAllen?
faqs.a: Call (956) 422-3335 or book an inspection online. We'll schedule a time to look at the roof and give you a written estimate. Estimates are free with no obligation.
